Description: "Defines the fundamental shape of the cross-section."
"Maximum area of the mesh elements. Smaller values yield finer meshes and higher accuracy but require more memory. Ex: 5.0"
"Depth (height) of the section. Mandatory if geometry_type is rectangular. Ex: 100.0"
"Width of the section. Mandatory if geometry_type is rectangular. Ex: 50.0"
"Diameter of the section. Mandatory if geometry_type is circular. Ex: 50.0"
"Number of points used to discretize the circular perimeter. Used if geometry_type is circular. Ex: 64"
"String representation of a 2D array containing [x, y] coordinates. Mandatory if geometry_type is polygon. Ex: [[0, 0], [10, 0], [10, 10], [0, 10]]"
